intro: Brave the frozen wilderness, build a shelter, and survive one more night.
description:
Alone in a frozen wilderness, every decision could be the difference between survival and a cold, silent end.

Explore a vast winter forest from a first-person perspective. Gather wood, stone, iron, berries, and other essential resources before hunger, freezing temperatures, or wild predators catch up with you. Craft the tools, weapons, clothing, and supplies you need to stay alive.

Turn an empty patch of wilderness into a secure survival base. Build a shelter, furnish it with a workbench, bed, and furnace, light a campfire, and prepare for the dangers waiting beyond its walls.

Hunt wolves, deer, hares, and birds using a bow, rifle, or shotgun. Cook food, monitor your health, hunger, and body temperature, and adapt as day gives way to night.

Your struggle is not only about survival. Explore the forest, complete story quests, uncover its secrets, and discover what happened to your missing father.

KEY FEATURES

• Explore an open winter wilderness
• Gather resources and craft essential equipment
• Build and furnish your own shelter
• Hunt wildlife and defend yourself from predators
• Survive cold, hunger, injuries, and changing conditions
• Experience a full day-and-night cycle
• Follow story quests and search for your missing father

Can you master the frozen forest and survive another day?
